limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return. Out-of-range values are clamped.

sort.description: Ranking column: `total` for three-mark guns across every tier, or `tier-<n>` for one tier (`tier-10`). Default `total`, which is also what an unrecognised value falls back to. Not an enum: which tiers the game has is Wargaming's to decide, and the response's `tiers` names the ones this region has a ranking for.
